question: I humbly request an episode with Felis after she became Crusch-sama! (note: sama is written in hiragana here, so this likely refers to after the memory loss)
answer: After she became Crusch-sama, she started wearing clothing that she wouldn't before, so Felis enjoyed helping her choose clothing. One day, Crusch-sama said she'd like to do the same with Felis, and she picked his clothing. It was something Crusch-sama (note: -sama in kanji, so referring to pre-memory-loss Crusch) previously picked out and given to him. Felis tried to endure it, but he cried.
